name: SQL Injection
summary: Track concatenated or interpolated input into SQL execution; recognize parameterized query APIs.

name: Cross-Site Scripting
sink: sink: HTML response, raw template output, DOM HTML sink
summary: Apply context-sensitive encoding and distinguish safe templating from raw output.

name: OS Command Injection
summary: Track untrusted input into shell interpreters and command strings; prefer argument arrays.

name: Path Traversal
summary: Check canonicalized resolved paths remain under the intended root.

name: Unsafe Deserialization
summary: Flag untrusted serialized bytes reaching unsafe deserialization.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery
summary: Validate scheme, host, DNS resolution and private/link-local destinations.

name: Open Redirect
summary: Require allowlisted destinations or same-origin validation.

name: Hardcoded Credentials
summary: Detect credential-shaped literals; suppress only known placeholders and test fixtures by policy.

name: Missing Authorization
summary: Compare sibling route policies and verify object-level authorization.

name: Insecure Direct Object Reference
summary: Verify ownership/tenant scope is enforced at the data access boundary.

name: Prototype Pollution
summary: Track tainted keys and dangerous merge operations.

name: Server-Side Template Injection
summary: Distinguish rendering data from compiling user-controlled template source.

name: Log Injection
summary: Detect control characters and untrusted fields entering security-sensitive logs.

name: Weak Cryptography
summary: Identify weak algorithms, modes, key sizes and insecure randomness.

name: Reachable Vulnerable Dependency
summary: Join advisory data with call-site reachability; don't equate installed with exploitable.

name: Webhook Signature Missing
summary: Require signature verification, timestamp freshness and replay protection.

name: Unsafe Memory / FFI Boundary
sink: sink: unsafe dereference or FFI call
summary: Review pointer provenance, bounds, ownership and lifetime.
